releaseInfo.releaseNotes:
Hypergamous Tree Chopping Simulator 3 - Update 1.1.7

- OBLIVION AWAKENS: the global relic case now unlocks at 500 million logs and charges 10% of your live balance per attempt. The one-of-one roll is server-decided, errors refund the exact cost, and the result stays in its own case display.
- AXE COLLECTION RESONANCE: your highest-value owned axe skin boosts all log output, scaling to a maximum +20% at 150,000 logs of sell value.
- COOP COMMERCE: sell one or all standard chickens for 50 logs each. Mutated and special flock members are untouched.
- CASE FLOW REFINED: every Oblivion entry point uses the same unlock and percentage pricing.
- Prestige, active automation, and offline-earnings behavior remain as in 1.1.6.
